decision_question: Which folder structure and control rules govern Kritva actuator feasibility studies?
options_considered: Ad hoc per-study structure; common standard v0.4 with common/ and registers/
decision: Adopt FEASIBILITY_STUDIES_STANDARD v0.4 as the proposed working baseline pending formal approval
rationale: Consistent traceable and reviewable evidence across Kritva-S/M/L; not an approved baseline until approval is recorded
